tasks.title: Scaffold Next.js app with declared check scripts (only if Q2 = scaffold)

tasks.title: Write failing unit tests for description rendering
tasks.description: Owner: implementation (no separate test author supplied). Test first: a project with a description renders it in font-sans with token colors only; a project without a description renders no empty element or dangling separator. Expected red: the description element is absent. Required proof: unit run fails before T005 and passes after.

tasks.title: Render project description on the chosen surface
tasks.description: Owner: implementation. Implement the surface chosen in Q1 using the existing row pattern (AGENTS.md:202-211). Use font-sans for the description, tokens only, no rounded corners, no hex. Required proof: T004 unit tests pass; integration check shows the text on the rendered page.

tasks.title: Integration and e2e checks against the rendered app
tasks.description: Owner: implementation. Write the integration test in the test-first order above (red before T005). Integration uses target http on the preview. E2E traverses the deployed app with a real browser. No third-party stand-ins are needed. Required proof: both checks pass; evidence uploaded with evidence upload and cited by path.
